name: Sorairo Memoir -Precious Summer Vacation!-
original_name: そらいろメモワール -Precious summer vacation！-
source:
Ryuu and his osananajimi Ichigo return to their hometown for the first time in 8 years. They decide to race to the top of the mountain. What reacquaintances and memories lie beyond the mountain?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
龙与青梅竹马莓时隔八年首次回到故乡。他们决定比赛谁先登上山顶。山的另一边，有怎样的重逢与回忆在等待着他们？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
